stories.title: Yogi Adityanath pitches Jewar as manufacturing hub
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath participated in the bhoomi pujan for a Rs 1,219-crore CNH tractor facility at Jewar. The Chief Minister stated that the airport is catalysing industrial investment, noting that the state has received investment proposals worth more than Rs 50 lakh crore over nine-and-a-half years.

stories.title: CNH to build new 100-acre tractor manufacturing facility in UP
stories.summary: CNH has commenced construction of a 100-acre manufacturing facility in Uttar Pradesh, with an annual production capacity of 1 lakh tractors at full scale. The first phase is expected to be operational by mid-2028. The project aims to strengthen the country's role in the company's global network.

stories.title: CNH to invest over $200 million in Jewar plant
stories.summary: CNH is investing over $200 million in a new plant in Jewar, with plans to export 25 percent of its production. The full text of this report is available to subscribers.

stories.title: Yogi Adityanath suggests CNH manufacture bulldozers in UP
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath suggested that CNH Industrial could manufacture bulldozers at its new tractor facility in Gautam Buddh Nagar. The Chief Minister described the bulldozer as a brand associated with the state and a symbol of his government's approach to crime and anti-encroachment efforts.

stories.title: Kia India announces $2 billion investment for second plant
stories.summary: Kia India has signed a memorandum of understanding with the government of Andhra Pradesh for a $2 billion investment in a second manufacturing plant. The 465-acre facility will produce internal combustion and electric vehicles, aiming for an annual capacity of two lakh units.

stories.title: Kia India confirms new ICE and electric cars
stories.summary: Kia India has confirmed plans for new internal combustion and electric vehicles following the announcement of its second manufacturing plant. The full report is available to subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: Landmark Group plans Rs 1,600 crore NCR expansion
stories.summary: Real estate firm Landmark Group will invest Rs 1,600 crore to build a 3 million sq ft office complex in Gurugram and a mixed-use development on the Dwarka Expressway. The company recently raised Rs 330 crore in construction finance from SBI for a separate commercial project.

stories.title: Tata Motors shares rise on commercial vehicle growth
stories.summary: Tata Motors shares rose 2.16 percent on November 12, 2026, following growth in the heavy truck and electric commercial vehicle segments. The company has partnered with Finzo EV Solutions to provide financing. Shares have gained 9 percent over four consecutive trading sessions.

stories.title: Tata Motors commercial vehicle shares gain for fourth day
stories.summary: Tata Motors commercial vehicle shares rose 4 percent on Thursday, marking a fourth consecutive day of gains. The stock has rallied 9 percent over the period, driven by reports of strong demand for heavy trucks and electric vehicles across the January to October 2026 period.

stories.title: Mahindra SUV sales reach record 73,338 units in October
stories.summary: Mahindra registered its highest-ever monthly SUV sales in October 2026, dispatching 73,338 units. The figure represents a 2.4 percent year-on-year increase and a 14.4 percent rise from September. Demand was led by the Scorpio, Bolero, Thar and XUV 7XO models.

stories.title: Kia India dispatches 33,462 units in October
stories.summary: Kia India recorded 33,462 domestic passenger vehicle dispatches in October 2026, a 13 percent increase from the previous year. Growth was driven by the Seltos and Syros models, which rose 88 percent and 161 percent respectively, despite declines in Sonet and Carens sales.

stories.title: Hyundai October sales rise 17 percent
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor India dispatched 62,799 passenger vehicles in October 2026, a 16.7 percent increase over October 2025. The Creta remained the brand's top-selling model, while the new Bayon contributed 3,449 units to the monthly total. Sales also rose 9.9 percent compared to September.

stories.title: Maruti Suzuki October sales grow 20 percent
stories.summary: Maruti Suzuki dispatched 2,12,384 passenger vehicles in October 2026, a 20 percent increase from the previous year. Six models, including the Brezza and Wagon R, each exceeded 20,000 units during the month. The company also recorded a 17 percent increase in sales compared to September.

stories.title: Hyundai reports 62,799 sales for October
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor India sold 62,799 units in October 2026, an increase of 16.74 percent from the previous year. The Creta was the top-selling model with 17,955 units, while the Venue reached a monthly record of 13,017 units. The new Bayon model debuted with 3,449 units.

stories.title: Maruti dominates top 10 bestseller list for October
stories.summary: The Indian automotive industry saw wholesale dispatches cross 5 lakh units in October 2026. Maruti Suzuki secured seven of the ten spots on the list of bestselling cars. The company is currently offering a personalised car buying journey to 50 readers.

stories.title: Maruti Brezza leads sub-4-metre SUV segment
stories.summary: The sub-4-metre SUV segment recorded 1,38,936 dispatches in October 2026, a 10.7 percent year-on-year increase. The Maruti Suzuki Brezza emerged as the bestseller, overtaking the Tata Nexon. Kia Sonet and Mahindra XUV 3XO recorded double-digit declines during the same period.

stories.title: Ertiga leads 6 and 7-seater segment in October
stories.summary: India's 6 and 7-seater segment recorded 1,07,960 units in October 2026, an 8.4 percent year-on-year increase. Maruti Suzuki's Ertiga remained the best-selling model, while Mahindra commanded a 43.4 percent market share in the segment through its Scorpio, Bolero, and XUV7XO models.

stories.title: New Toyota Fortuner expected in 2027
stories.summary: The next-generation Toyota Fortuner is expected to be showcased globally on December 1, 2026. While Toyota has not confirmed an official debut date for the Indian market, the SUV is expected to arrive in 2027. The full details are available to subscribers.

stories.title: Hyundai to launch CNG variant of Bayon SUV
stories.summary: Hyundai will launch a CNG variant of its Bayon SUV by January. The model, which starts at Rs 9.99 lakh, will be the company's first SUV over 4 metres to feature factory-fitted CNG. The brand is currently adjusting its strategy to focus on the popular SUV segment.

stories.title: Yamaha debuts Tenere 4 concept at EICMA 2026
stories.summary: Yamaha has unveiled the Tenere 4 Concept at EICMA 2026, a lightweight adventure bike designed for the European A2 licence category. The model features a new engine and off-road hardware, sitting below the Tenere 700. Yamaha has not yet confirmed a date for the production version.

stories.title: TVS unveils Apache RTR 125 at EICMA 2026
stories.summary: TVS has introduced the Apache RTR 125 at EICMA 2026, featuring a 14.7bhp liquid-cooled engine and dual-channel ABS. Positioned as the brand's sportiest 125cc naked motorcycle, the bike includes a six-speed gearbox. An India launch for the model is currently under consideration.

stories.title: Electric three-wheelers dominate October retail sales
stories.summary: Electric three-wheelers accounted for 62.63% of India's 3-wheeler retail market in October 2026, up from 52.19% in October 2025. Total retail sales reached 1,41,420 units, with 88,570 of those being electric models. The segment continues to favour electric power over petrol, diesel, and CNG alternatives.

stories.title: Hero Xpulse 450 enters middleweight adventure segment
stories.summary: Hero MotoCorp has unveiled the Xpulse 450, featuring a 421cc engine and rally-developed hardware. The motorcycle is designed to compete with the Royal Enfield Himalayan 450, which uses a 452cc engine. Both bikes are aimed at riders looking for highway and off-road capability.

stories.title: Yamaha to launch Xenter E electric scooter in 2027
stories.summary: Yamaha has revealed the Xenter E, a big-wheel electric scooter designed for the European market. Production will take place in Vietnam, with a launch scheduled for the spring of 2027. The company also showcased a concept for a petrol-powered variant of the same scooter.

stories.title: Royal Enfield introduces Himalayan 750
stories.summary: Royal Enfield has launched the Himalayan 750, described as the company's most powerful road-going motorcycle. The manufacturer chose to host the debut near Mount Etna, an active volcano. The bike represents a new effort by the brand to capture the middleweight adventure segment.

stories.title: Bajaj Pulsar 125 features premium tech
stories.summary: The Bajaj Pulsar 125 offers a range of features typically reserved for larger motorcycles, according to the autoX Awards. The model is positioned at the premium end of the entry-level commuter segment. Manufacturers are increasingly adding high-end specifications to meet rising consumer expectations.

stories.title: Royal Enfield Bullet 650 struggles on track
stories.summary: The Royal Enfield Bullet 650 was tested at the Buddh International Circuit, where its weight and suspension setup hindered performance. While the 648cc parallel-twin engine provides strong torque, the bike is not designed for aggressive track riding. It remains a cruiser rather than a racer.

stories.title: Hero showcases Xpulse Scrambler 250 concept
stories.summary: Hero MotoCorp revealed the Xpulse Scrambler 250 Concept at EICMA 2026, featuring retro styling and a road-oriented design. The concept departs from the adventure-focused nature of the existing Xpulse family, incorporating modern hardware and a distinctive lighting signature. No production timeline was provided.

stories.title: Electric passenger vehicle sales pass 300,000 units
stories.summary: Electric passenger vehicle registrations reached 3,04,701 between January 1 and November 9, 2026, surpassing the 2025 total of 195,571. October alone saw 37,516 registrations. This marks the first time annual sales have crossed the three-lakh milestone, with several weeks remaining in the year.

stories.title: Ola Electric narrows quarterly loss
stories.summary: Ola Electric reported a consolidated loss of 3.62 billion rupees for the quarter ended September 30, compared to 4.18 billion rupees a year earlier. The company attributed the improvement to workforce restructuring and cost-control measures. Expenses fell by 28.4% during the period.

stories.title: Ola Electric revenue drops 41 percent
stories.summary: Ola Electric's net loss narrowed to 362 crore rupees in the September quarter, while total income fell 40.7% to 448 crore rupees. The company is transitioning from company-run stores to a dealer network and has stopped accepting orders for certain models.

stories.title: Mahindra electric SUV sales exceed 100,000
stories.summary: Mahindra has reached 100,000 sales for its electric SUVs, including the XUV400 and XUV 3XO. The company reported that the XEV 9S was its highest-selling electric model in the second quarter of 2026, with 13,275 units sold. Production plans are being expanded to meet demand.

stories.title: Ola Electric shifts to dealer-led retail
stories.summary: Ola Electric reported a September-quarter loss of 362 crore rupees, down from 418 crore rupees last year. Revenue fell 39% as the company replaces its direct-to-consumer network with dealers. The firm noted that supply constraints are currently limiting its automotive business growth.

stories.title: Ola Electric sales decline despite cost cuts
stories.summary: Ola Electric has implemented cost-cutting measures, yet sales figures for the company have slipped. The full piece is for subscribers. Further details were thin in the open report.

stories.title: GreenLine Mobility to deploy electric trucks
stories.summary: GreenLine Mobility Solutions has partnered with Kirloskar Ferrous Industries to deploy electric trucks at the Taloja facility in Navi Mumbai. The logistics operator, an Essar Group venture, focuses on LNG and electric-powered heavy commercial vehicles for its goods transportation operations.

stories.title: Electric van ZEV mandate targets explained
stories.summary: The UK government's Zero Emission Vehicle mandate requires manufacturers to sell an increasing proportion of electric vans each year. Introduced in 2024, the rules aim to accelerate the shift away from petrol and diesel. Manufacturers face financial penalties if they fail to meet their annual obligations.

stories.title: CEAT Specialty expands Ambernath manufacturing capacity
stories.summary: CEAT Specialty is expanding its Ambernath plant, with plans to increase production capacity from 105 tonnes per day to 160 tonnes per day over the next 45 to 60 days. The facility produces agricultural radial, steel, forestry, and Very High Flexion tyres for the global market.

stories.summary: ContiTech is expanding its Pune R&D facility to include India's first dedicated Surface Solutions Colour Lab. The lab will support colour development and material testing for automotive interiors, primarily for Indian customers and the Asia-Pacific region.

stories.title: Tenneco India Q2 FY27 revenue up 34.2 percent
stories.summary: Tenneco Clean Air India reported a 32.2 percent year-on-year increase in second-quarter value-added revenue to Rs 15,229 million. EBITDA grew 20.7 percent to Rs 2,616 million. The company supplies clean air, powertrain, and ride technology solutions to major original equipment manufacturers.

stories.title: Talbros Automotive targets revenue growth for FY27
stories.summary: Talbros Automotive is targeting up to ₹1,100 crore in FY27 revenue, with management expecting 18 to 20 percent growth in FY28. The company plans ₹100 crore in capital expenditure, supported by new programmes in chassis and gaskets. Its data centre business is also expected to grow.

stories.title: Brokerage identifies eight auto ancillary stocks with upside
stories.summary: Monarch Networth Capital has issued buy ratings for eight auto ancillary stocks, including Minda Corporation and RK Forgings, citing strong festive demand and improved vehicle affordability. The brokerage identified these stocks as having up to 63 percent upside potential, noting that current valuations appear attractive.

stories.title: Talbros Automotive reports record quarterly revenue
stories.summary: Talbros Automotive posted record net sales of 263.21 crore rupees, a 23.49 percent increase year-on-year. Operating margins contracted to 16.31 percent from 17.28 percent in March 2026, as the company navigated rising input costs. The firm says it is well-positioned to capitalise on the recovering automotive market.

stories.title: Motorpoint expands auction platform to 12 sites
stories.summary: Motorpoint has opened its 12th Auction4Cars site in Norwich. The company says it is focused on convenience as it expands its UK network.

stories.summary: Spinny delivered 9,377 used cars during the festive season, a 39 percent increase compared to the same period last year. SUVs, automatics, and CNG vehicles led the growth, with Delhi-NCR recording a 63 percent rise in deliveries. The company says car choices are evolving.

stories.title: Festive used car sales reach 6 lakh units
stories.summary: Industry estimates suggest 5.5 to 6 lakh used cars were sold across India during the Navratri-Diwali period, up from fewer than 5 lakh last year. Increased access to financing and first-time buyers drove demand. Total financing for new and used cars reportedly exceeded 1,000 crore rupees.

stories.title: Used car sales rise in South Africa
stories.summary: Used vehicle sales in South Africa reached 36,046 units in October, an 8.2 percent increase year-on-year. Toyota remained the top-selling brand with 6,871 units. While sales volume grew, average prices for used vehicles fell during the month. The market remains active.

stories.summary: Indian customs authorities are holding bulk Scotch whisky shipments from Pernod Ricard and Diageo. Investigators are pushing for a 150 percent import tariff, arguing the shipments are compound alcoholic preparations rather than finished whisky. The dispute challenges a trade pact intended to lower duties on British spirits.

stories.title: India prohibits lithium-ion battery black mass exports
stories.summary: India has banned the export of lithium-ion battery black mass to secure feedstock for domestic recycling. The Directorate General of Foreign Trade amended the policy from free to prohibited with immediate effect. The move aims to recover critical minerals used in electric vehicles.

stories.title: India Inc overseas borrowings exceed 7 billion dollars
stories.summary: Indian companies registered 7.04 billion dollars in external commercial borrowings and foreign currency convertible bonds in September. Large infrastructure, energy, and telecom firms led the activity. The Reserve Bank of India data shows the majority of registrations occurred under the general permission route.

stories.summary: India's central bank is drafting rules to prevent private equity firms from holding controlling stakes in more than one non-bank lender. The proposal aims to mitigate contagion risks if a global firm faces financial stress. The central bank is currently concerned about the potential for systemic cross-firm impact.

stories.title: Digital dispute resolution platform struggles with volume
stories.summary: A government-backed portal for small business payment disputes has resolved only 10.3% of complaints received since June 2025. Of 39,033 filings, only 4,030 have been processed through AI, arbitration, or conciliation. The platform was designed to address the scale of delayed payments in the small enterprise sector.

stories.title: Alphabet bond sales attract $5 billion in early orders
stories.summary: Alphabet's debut bond sales in Hong Kong and Singapore drew $5 billion in early orders. The company intends to use the capital to accelerate investment in AI infrastructure. Despite recent volatility in technology shares, investors appear willing to fund the company's expansion into hardware and data centers.

stories.title: GM updates technology roadmap with AI and new EV platform
stories.summary: GM unveiled a fourth-generation EV platform using LMR batteries to increase range. The company claims AI simulations cut battery development time in half. GM plans to skip SAE Level 3 autonomy in favor of Level 4 hands-off driving by 2028. The company is now an AI-powered business.

stories.summary: The Union Cabinet has extended the Stand-Up India scheme until March 31, 2031, aiming to support 2.5 lakh additional entrepreneurs from women, Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. A Rs 4,111-crore credit guarantee corpus was approved to facilitate lending. The scheme has supported 2.75 lakh entrepreneurs since 2016.

stories.title: RBI considers limits on private equity ownership of NBFCs
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is drafting proposals to prevent private equity firms from holding controlling stakes in more than one non-banking financial company. Regulators fear that financial stress at a global firm could trigger contagion across multiple lenders. Smaller investments would remain subject to less scrutiny.

stories.title: Indian Supercross Racing League auction hits record spending
stories.summary: The Indian Supercross Racing League concluded its Season 3 rider auction with teams spending over Rs 4.5 crore. A total of 42 riders were signed from a pool of 135 candidates. Australian racer Luke Clout secured the highest bid at Rs 21.46 lakh for the upcoming championship.

stories.title: Stellantis recycling unit receives environmental recognition
stories.summary: Stellantis brand Circular Autopeças has been recognised by Brazil’s Ministry of the Environment for its vehicle recycling operations. In its first year, the unit dismantled 1,150 vehicles and sold over 11,000 reused components. The company was honoured under the nation's new Recycling Incentive Law.

stories.title: Report highlights uneven EV progress across Europe
stories.summary: Europe’s transition to zero-emission mobility faces significant disparities in infrastructure and vehicle uptake, according to Transport and Mobility Leuven. While some nations report market shares exceeding 50 percent, others remain below 10 percent. Zero-emission vehicles accounted for 23 percent of new registrations through September 2026.

stories.summary: Mercedes-Benz has reportedly frozen investments in its German operations and is exploring potential plant closures. stories.summary: Tesla is reportedly moving to end production of the Cybertruck. The vehicle, which launched with significant fanfare, has faced ongoing scrutiny regarding its manufacturing complexity and market reception. stories.title: Nvidia auto strategy faces uncertainty after Jensen Huang exit
stories.summary: Nvidia’s automotive future is facing questions following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang. The company has been a key supplier of chips for advanced driver-assistance systems. Meanwhile, Honda has set a target of 1.6 million U.S. sales. The impact of the leadership change remains to be seen.

stories.title: Tesla and Rivian lead U.S. EV market after tax credit repeal
stories.summary: Tesla and Rivian have tightened their grip on the U.S. electric vehicle market following the repeal of federal tax credits. Legacy automakers have seen their market share fade as the industry adjusts to the new policy landscape. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.summary: Audi plans to embrace scarcity with its upcoming Nuvolari supercar, targeting price points that exceed those of Bentley and Lamborghini. The company aims to redefine its luxury standing through limited availability and premium positioning. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.summary: Mercedes is betting on a 100 percent China for China production strategy to mitigate rising costs in Germany. The move reflects a broader industry trend of localizing supply chains to remain competitive. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.summary: Porsche has identified 2027 as the year for its financial turnaround, doubling down on its existing luxury strategy to drive growth. The company is focusing on high-end market segments to recover performance. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Magna targets 2030 growth through China and non-auto sectors
stories.summary: Magna is planning for strong growth through 2030 by leveraging partnerships with Chinese automakers and expanding into non-automotive markets. The supplier aims to diversify its revenue streams beyond traditional vehicle manufacturing. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: German automakers accelerate domestic production cuts
stories.summary: German automakers are accelerating production cuts at home as they face a reckoning in the Chinese market. The shift comes as companies struggle to balance domestic manufacturing costs with global demand. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Global EV sales rise 8 percent in October
stories.summary: Global electric vehicle sales rose 8 percent year-on-year to 2.09 million units in October, according to Benchmark Mineral Intelligence. While European demand surged 36 percent, total worldwide sales dipped 3 percent from September. Growth is currently finding its way back to the road.
